open_points.subject: FlowEdge guard skipping with FlowConstant
open_points.text: “a port fed by a constant receives it and is never skipped”
open_points.question: Is the constant exception only per input port, so another input port that can no longer receive a value still makes the node `skipped_by_guard`, or does any constant-fed input prevent that node status?
options: The exception is per port; another unavailable input still skips the node
Any constant-fed input prevents the whole node from being skipped
open_points.default_guess: The exception is per port; another unavailable input still skips the node

open_points.subject: FlowEdge and FlowConstant competing producers
open_points.text: “a port fed by a constant receives it and is never skipped”
open_points.question: May an input port fed by a constant also have incoming edges, and if so which source supplies the port when an edge can deliver?
options: Such a port may not also have incoming edges
The constant is a fallback used only when no edge delivers
The constant and edges may both deliver to the port
open_points.default_guess: Such a port may not also have incoming edges

open_points.subject: NodeExecution skip-status precedence
open_points.question: What exact scope makes both statuses apply: failures and guard-disabled inputs anywhere on the same node, only competing causes on the same input port, or also an upstream failure on an edge to a constant-fed port?
options: Any upstream-failure condition on the node overrides any `skipped_by_guard` condition on that node
Precedence applies only when both causes concern the same input port
Precedence also applies to failed incoming edges on constant-fed ports
open_points.default_guess: Any upstream-failure condition on the node overrides any `skipped_by_guard` condition on that node
